facts.fact: MISPA's chair says the Malawi Internet Exchange (MIX), owned and operated by the ISP association since 2008, keeps local traffic local, with all ISPs connected and peering on a route server.
MISPA's chair says the MIX provides international CDN caches from Google, Facebook and Akamai.

systems.platform: internet exchange point, in equipment procurement

MWI.note: Mentions ESCOM fibre and a planned Nacala to Lilongwe fibre with no works or service stated.
Says Malawi is landlocked with no direct submarine cable and ISPs have international gateways; no fibre route to a named neighbour stated.
No share of the population using the internet.
Gives wholesale transit prices only, no mobile data price.
